localization.promotional_text: Find memorable places, build your adventure list and keep your travel notes together. Explore classic experiences and optional one-time hidden-gem collections.
localization.description:
Make your next adventure one to remember.

Wayfinder helps you discover real places worth going, save the experiences that interest you and keep track of the ones you have completed. Browse more than 5,300 adventures around the world, with practical context about the experience, indicative costs and the best time to visit.

PLAN YOUR OWN WAY
Explore destinations by continent and country, save a shortlist and organise adventures into trips. Use Near me when you choose, or browse manually without sharing your location. Travel warnings remain visible, and destinations marked do not travel are excluded from automatic suggestions.

SHARE WITH A GROUP
When you create or join a group, choose once whether to share eligible adventure ticks, completion dates, star ratings and written memories. Group Memories shows each sharing person’s entries together. Entries already shared remain under your name in that group after you leave; you can erase that saved group history later, and account or group deletion removes it. Your photos, purchases and shortlist do not join group sharing.

KEEP YOUR MEMORIES
Add notes, ratings and photos to your completed adventures. Wayfinder keeps its in-app photo copies on the phone where you add them; it does not automatically upload or sync them. You can choose to save copies to your iPhone or iPad Photos library; your Photos and iCloud settings then govern those copies. You can manually export a password-encrypted photo backup and import it into the same Wayfinder account on another phone. Sign in to the same account to access synced progress; Wayfinder in-app photos appear on another phone only when you deliberately transfer and import the backup files. Previously loaded catalogue content and phone-local memories remain available offline. Keep an independent copy of anything important.

DISCOVER HIDDEN GEMS
Classic adventures are included. Optional one-time purchases unlock hidden-gem guide collections for individual geographic packs or all continents together. The All continents collection also includes Antarctica. Purchases belong to your individual Wayfinder account.

Wayfinder provides discovery and planning information. Some adventures include a clearly labelled paid link to a matching Viator experience. Bookings, payment and cancellation take place with Viator and the provider; RL Applications may earn a commission. Travel, admission, permits, accommodation and guide fees are separate from Wayfinder purchases. Costs and opening or access information can change, so check current information with the relevant venue or authority before travelling.

An account is required. Uninstalling the app or clearing its data can remove phone-local memories that you have not exported.

Developed by RL Applications. Support: help.rlapplications@gmail.com

review_contact.notes:
Wayfinder is a travel checklist and guide. Sign in using the private verified review-account credentials supplied in App Review Information. An account is required. The eight non-consumable purchases unlock digital guide content, not travel or admission; All continents covers every geographic pack and Antarctica. Me → Paid collections includes Restore purchases. Near me requests foreground location only after selection; manual browsing is available.

For 1.2.0, Me → Groups & sharing lets you create or join a group with a six-character code. The single prompt chooses either sharing eligible personal completion ticks, dates, star ratings and written notes together, or joining privately. Group Memories shows each consenting member’s dated entry and note. Older entries of uncertain origin remain anonymous with private feedback until their owner reviews the personal adventure and taps Confirm for group sharing. New eligible personal entries do not need that extra confirmation. If a sharing member leaves, the group retains a frozen copy of what it could already see under that member’s name; later personal edits do not change that copy. The former member can use Me → Groups & sharing → Shared history in groups you left to erase it. Account or group deletion also removes it. Shared trips follow a separate rule: leaving unshares the trip while the personal trip remains. No photos join group sharing.

Me contains Support & help, Privacy policy, Delete my account and all my data, a guided tour, encrypted photo export/import and iPhone/iPad Save photos to camera roll. New in-app photo copies stay on the originating device; the optional camera-roll action copies them only to that device’s Photos library after confirmation. Viator buttons are labelled paid links and lead to a matching third-party booking page. Community recommendations are text-only and pre-moderated.
